name: research-loop
description: Prompt-driven research loop for any field: rounds of retrieve, plan, experiment, validate, and next step, each node an agent following its own prompt, until the next-step node decides to stop or a hard limit is reached; then a write-up
whenToUse: Call when the user asks to research, investigate, or continue researching a question in a science-agent workspace whose objective has a `research:` block. The script only sequences nodes; every judgment (what to read, what to test, how to analyze, whether a result holds, what to do next, when to stop) is made by the node agents from their prompts in plugin/agents/research-*.md.

phases.title: Open
phases.detail: open or resume a round; hard limits only

phases.title: Retrieve
phases.detail: retrieve-search, then retrieve-read per focus and retrieve-refine, repeated until enough

phases.title: Plan
phases.detail: plan: experiments and their analysis, recorded before anything runs

phases.title: Experiment
phases.detail: per experiment: build, then run and debug until it runs

phases.title: Validate
phases.detail: per experiment: check, then challenge and recheck until no blocking objection

phases.title: Next step
phases.detail: next-step: state of knowledge, next-step plan, continue or stop
